tasks.title: Pocket control, throwaway, slide, sack fall and simplified on-field passing controls (C-2, C-3)
tasks.spec:
Engine (engine.ts, types.ts, autopilot.ts):
- Drop: a scripted 0.75 s drop to los-6.5. The QB's act is backpedal while moving and stance when set, so the players' existing clips render it.
- Pocket movement: a human Pt steer during a pass drop (t >= 0.45 s) moves the QB at up to lerp(3.6, 5.0, rt(AGI)) yd/s. That velocity feeds throwErrorRadius's movement term, and sight() gets a movement penalty. With null input (the AI) the QB keeps his spot, plus a 0.8 yd step-up when the edge is free.
- outsideBox(p): |qb.x - bx| > 4.5, or past the line of scrimmage.
- throwTo also allows scramble throws before the line of scrimmage.
- New throwAway(p), legal only outside the box: Ball.away is skipped by lane plays, and arrive() makes it an incompletion with the text 'THROWN AWAY'. Inside the box it returns false.
- New slide(p) for a QB carrier past the line: ends as a tackle with no fumble roll.
- On a sack: act(qb, 'down') and act(rusher, 'tackle'). No new RNG draws.

UI:
- New ReceiverIcons.tsx and pass-controls.css: per-receiver buttons over their heads, positioned each frame through refs from renderer.screenOf. 44 px hit areas, route-coloured discs with jersey numbers. A tap leads the receiver.
- A throw-type chip, BULLET / AUTO / LOB (AUTO by distance, the default). A second-finger tap during a slingshot drag toggles BULLET and LOB, as in Retro Bowl.
- Pass-layout pref perfect-season:fb2-pass-layout ('field' default, or 'panel' to keep the old panel).
- The left stick moves the QB in the pocket.
- RUN IT stays. A THROW AWAY button is enabled only outside the box. SLIDE replaces SPIN for a QB past the line.
- A faint landing reticle while the ball is in the air. The name chip shows regardless of sight.

tasks.title: Passing calibration: depth curve, facing-ball interceptions, deep balls, YAC, target spread, top-tier balance, sacks and QB reads by awareness (G-2, G-3, G-4)
tasks.spec:
Changes in engine.ts and autopilot.ts:
- Facing rule: facingBall(d, at). An interception is possible only when the angle from the defender's heading to the ball is <= 75 degrees and t >= breakAt. Otherwise the INT chance becomes a deflection. Applies in playPassingLane and arrive().
- INT shape: lane-pick chance capped at 0.35. Contested INT chance scaled by air yards: x0.3 behind the line, x0.6 at 0-9, x1.0 at 10-19, x1.4 at 20+. Ballhawk becomes additive +0.05.
- Deep balls (G-2):
  - Deep zone defenders and the Cover 1 FS stay at least 1.5 yd deeper than the deepest receiver until the throw.
  - On long-flight touch or lob throws, deep defenders break on the ball 0.06 s sooner.
  - A trailing defender within reach on a high ball cuts the catch chance by 0.08-0.15.
- YAC: defenders turning to pursue after a catch pay a reaction lag of lerp(0.35, 0.15, PRC).
- Top tier (G-4): routeWinChance clamped to [0.15, 0.85], a floor on coverage lag, and the lane-play chance capped at 0.55.
- QB reads (G-3): a READS[concept] ordered read list, with Z primary in Smash and Flood. The pilot visits reads in order:
  - first read at 1.0-1.4 s
  - each next read lerp(0.55, 0.32, AWR) s later
  - number of reads 1/2/3/4 by AWR (<60, 60-79, 80-89, 90+)
  - the RB checkdown only after the reads or when hurried
  This sets the AI's time to throw at 2.4-3.0 s.
- AI scramble when pressured with a 5+ yd lane.
- Sack timing tuned so a typical sack lands at 3.2-3.8 s while pressure still arrives near 2.9 s.
- UI: receiver icons show the open tint only on the first N reads.
- tune.test.ts and human.test.ts move onto sim-kit.
acceptance: Always-on: a facingBall unit test passes; over 2,000 seeded passes, no interception by a defender facing more than 75 degrees away from the ball

CAL, AI Pro gold v gold, 300 games: completion 62-67%; by depth: behind the line 74-84%, 0-9 67-77%, 10-19 49-61%, 20+ 30-42%; INT 1.8-2.6% and rising band by band with depth; sacks 5.5-8.5% (baseline 2.7); time to throw 2.4-3.0 s (baseline 1.4-1.6); YAC 4.2-5.8; Y/A 6.3-8.0; 20+ yd gains 7-11% of attempts; scrambles 3-7%

tasks.title: Run game distribution, distinct run plays, contact and gang tackles, directed moves, dive and protect, drive-long stamina (G-1, G-5, C-4)
tasks.spec:

- Inside: double team at the point of attack, then climb to the MLB.
- Power: the backside guard pulls (new Job 'pull').
- Outside: the stretch landmark plus a backside cutback lane when the DE crashes.
- Lane choice by BCV.

Second-level variance:
- LB overrun or misfit on 10-20% of runs, by PRC.
- Safety angle error scaled by (1-PUR) and speed.
- The pursuit closing burst reduced from +4-8% to +2-5%.

G-5 contact: a successful tackle opens p.contact for 0.3-0.6 s.
- The carrier drives forward by STR/TRK/weight against TAK/HIT/weight.
- Each extra defender within 1.2 yd joins as a gang tackle and shortens the contact by 0.15 s.
- The play ends at the spot with 'TACKLED BY <tag>' (or '<tag> & <tag>').

C-4 moves:
- The JUKE direction comes from the stick's field-x or a swipe on the button.
- DIVE: +1.0-1.5 yd, fumble chance x0.3. Reaching at the goal line: +0.3 yd, fumble chance x1.5 if hit.
- PROTECT hold: fumble chance x0.3, speed x0.9.
- Stamina across a drive: a transient Game.fatigue per RB, recovering +0.35 between plays, reset at the end of the drive, shown before the snap.

Retro Bowl touches:
- Automatic stiff arm and hurdle, at a seeded 0.25x a manual move's edge, never guaranteed.
- Hold POWER for 0.4-0.6 s to charge a truck: speed x0.85 while charging, +0.1 edge on release.

A-1 hooks: the RB gets act 'catch' at the mesh, and downed non-carriers get act 'getup' after 0.8-1.2 s for the players team to map.

- Tap 2: a horizontal accuracy needle with sweep period lerp(0.85, 1.35, rt(KAC)) s and window half-width lerp(0.10, 0.22, rt(KAC)) x a distance factor, with no shared floor.

tasks.spec:
Earned zones replace the ABILITY_ON coin flip. Game.zones is transient, and each of the 16 abilities enters on a visible trigger and leaves on a knockout:
- QB: a 20+ air-yard completion / a sack or INT.
- WR/TE: 2 catches of 10+ / 3 straight plays not targeted.
- RB: 2 runs of 8+ / a run for a loss.
- OL: clean dropbacks / a sack allowed.
- DL: a sack or TFL / a 20+ yd gain allowed.
- LB/DB: a PBU, INT or big hit / a 20+ yd catch allowed.
- Big Leg stays always on.
While in the zone the effect fires on about 50% of eligible plays (seeded), shown with chips and a meter.

Defensive On Fire:
- Lights after 2 straight sacks or a takeaway: rushers win 0.3 s sooner and run 3% faster.
- Goes out on a 10+ yd first down allowed.
- Applies to the AI defense in every mode and to your defense in solo.

Precision Passing (pref perfect-season:fb2-precision; on at Legend, off at Rookie and Pro): a bullet release ring. Releasing in the lerp(90, 160) ms green multiplies throw error by 0.7. Early or late is normal accuracy, never a forced miss.

SNAG catch tap: +0.12 contested-catch chance in a coverage-scaled window (200/140/90 ms). Missing the tap never forces a drop.

G-6: render-only INT and fumble return animations (skippable, no score change) and a 0.6 s incompletion bounce.

A-1: confirm the players team's act mappings (getup, cut, stiff_arm, truck) and list gaps.

- Every QA script (joystick, rushing, core-gameplay, play-feedback, gameplay, online, and all nfl-*) at 393, 430, 320 and 844L plus reduced motion.
- A full CAL re-run.
- A 4x-throttle performance run on port 5216.
- The final screenshot set.
- nfl.md completed with before/after tables, Protocol bump lines, Touched outside my lane and Owner device checks.

Defensive On Fire lights after 2 straight sacks or a takeaway and goes out on a 10+ yd first down allowed
